svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - rib core
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · BOTTOM LANDS OFFSET ½ PITCH
SCALE 2:1 · ON THE CENTRE LAND (x = 0), RUN-OUT FROM y = 150; TOP FLUTES MIRROR IT
MATERIAL: PA-CF (CARBON-FIBRE-FILLED NYLON), E ≈ 4 GPa, ρ 1.18 g/cm³. DRY THE FILAMENT BEFORE PRINTING.
PRINT FLAT, 100 % SOLID: WALL 1.6 = 4 PERIMETERS (0.4 NOZZLE), 0.2 LAYERS. NO SUPPORTS (45° RUN-OUTS).
THICKNESS 10 ±0.1. BOTH FACES ARE BOND SURFACES, FLAT WITHIN 0.1.
WAVE RIB λ18, WALL 1.6, CENTRE-LINE AMPLITUDE 5.2; CRESTS CUT FLAT = LANDS 4.28 ON BOTH FACES.
FRAME 6, CLOSED. SOLID TO y = 150; EACH FLUTE STARTS WITH A 45° RUN-OUT, 10 LONG (D–D).
M3 HEAT-SET INSERT BORE Ø4 × 7 + Ø3.2 × 15 IN THE BUTT FACE (GRIP SCREW) – SEE PB-GR-002.
BONDING: ABRADE (P120) AND DEGREASE BOTH FACES; THE SHEETS ARE LAMINATED ON IN THE MOULD (SHEET 4).
PRINT FILE output/rib_support/hybrid_rib_support.stl: ONE PIECE, FLAT, BED ≥ 391 × 196.
IT DROPS INTO THE MOULD POCKET (+0.2 CLEARANCE); PLUG THE INSERT BORE BEFORE MOULDING.
MASS 204 g. y FROM THE GRIP BUTT FACE (y = 0); THE RIB SUPPORT STARTS AT y = 5.
